note: The Genesis Epics, designed one by one: each a material of its own (how the light takes him), a prop no other gnome has (web/lib/gnomes/props.ts), his own trail and his own holing (no two Epics share a holing and its colour). concept is the design's reason, kept here for the design bible; the catalogue takes name and line. Colours are vocab.ts COLOURS names; materialColour is the material's detail (grain, paint, icing, stitches, neon light, a metal's band).

epics.name: Old Tock
epics.concept: A clockwork garden gnome: brass hat, silver body, wound by a key in his back.
epics.line: Wound every morning at seven. Plays eighteen holes before he winds down.

epics.name: Sprinkles
epics.concept: A tin garden ornament with a copper watering can on its brim.
epics.line: Carries a copper can on the brim. The greens have never looked so smug.

epics.name: Bramble Oak
epics.concept: Carved from the oak by hole 4; an acorn of the same tree on his hat.
epics.line: Carved from the oak by hole 4. Swears the acorn on top is his.

epics.name: Glazed Gus
epics.concept: The garden gnome of every lawn: glazed ceramic, red hat, blue coat, a spade.
epics.line: Forty summers on a lawn holding a spade. Finally gets to swing something else.

epics.name: Mossback
epics.concept: A stone garden statue, lichen in his cracks, a snail on his hat.
epics.line: A snail has lived on his hat since 1903. Neither will move first.

epics.name: Pippa Porcelain
epics.concept: A porcelain figurine painted with roses, a chipped teacup on her brim.
epics.line: Painted roses, a chipped teacup, nerves of fine china.

epics.name: Woolly Fern
epics.concept: A knitted gnome from a rainy weekend; the needles still in his hat.
epics.line: Knitted on a rainy weekend. Loses a stitch in every bunker.

epics.name: Neon Nettle
epics.concept: The garden centre's sign come to life: lime light, a sunflower lit on his hat.
epics.line: Glows like the garden centre's sign. The bees are confused, and so is the moon.

epics.name: Captain Koi
epics.concept: A glazed pond gnome; the koi he fished leaps off his hat.
epics.line: Fished the garden pond for years. The koi came along to keep an eye on him.

epics.name: Heron Hob
epics.concept: A walnut carving of a fisherman, rod over his shoulder, still as a heron.
epics.line: Stands on one foot for hours. Calls it his putting stance.

epics.name: Bosun Brass
epics.concept: A ship's brass fitting of a bosun, whistle on a chain.
epics.line: Pipes all hands on deck for a two-foot putt.

epics.name: Figurehead Fen
epics.concept: A ship's figurehead, chestnut wood, a helm wheel on her back.
epics.line: Spent a century on the front of a ship. Prefers the front of the queue.

epics.name: Delft Dory
epics.concept: A blue-and-white Delft figure of a sailor, an anchor at his chest.
epics.line: Blue and white from the cap down. Chips if you look at him wrong.

epics.name: Lighthouse Lou
epics.concept: A glazed lighthouse keeper; the lantern room on his hat stays lit.
epics.line: Keeps a light on top for ships, and for anyone looking for the cup.

epics.name: Shellback Sam
epics.concept: Sandstone from the reef, barnacled, a conch at his side.
epics.line: Barnacles on the elbows, sand in the beard. Hears the sea in every hole.

epics.name: Neon Palms
epics.concept: The beach bar's sign: a pink-lit deckhand under a lit palm.
epics.line: Lit up like a beach bar at midnight. Plays best after sunset.

epics.name: Spyglass Sal
epics.concept: A bronze lookout, spyglass drawn, silver coat.
epics.line: Spots the cup from the tee. Then spots three more, just in case.

epics.name: Knotty Ned
epics.concept: A cable-knit fisherman's jumper of a gnome, rope coiled on his shoulder.
epics.line: Ties a knot for every birdie. The rope is getting long.

epics.name: Gull Patrol
epics.concept: A glazed seaside souvenir, a gull settled on his bandana.
epics.line: The gull came for the chips and stayed for the golf.

epics.name: Pearl
epics.concept: Mother-of-pearl porcelain, an oyster on her cap, its pearl showing.
epics.line: Found the pearl in a bunker. Kept the shell as a hat.

epics.name: Gingersnap
epics.concept: A gingerbread gnome iced in white, rolling pin on his back.
epics.line: Baked at dawn, iced by noon. Smells better than he putts.

epics.name: Sugarplum
epics.concept: Gingerbread with pink icing and a cupcake for a crown.
epics.line: A cupcake on top and sprinkles everywhere else. Sweeter than the course deserves.

epics.name: Pewter Pot
epics.concept: A pewter kitchen ornament: a baker whisking, steam on every holing.
epics.line: Whisks between strokes. The putts come out light and fluffy.

epics.name: Easel Ezra
epics.concept: A carved artist's mannequin with a real palette.
epics.line: Paints every hole before playing it. The paintings get the pars.

epics.name: Neon Noir
epics.concept: An artist of the night: a cyan neon brush through a plum beret.
epics.line: An artist of the night. Signs every hole in light.

epics.name: Tick Tilly
epics.concept: A porcelain figurine wound to the town clock, its face on her top hat.
epics.line: Wound to the town clock. Never late for a tee time, never early either.

epics.name: Pigeon Square
epics.concept: The town square's statue on his day off; the pigeon came anyway.
epics.line: The town square's statue, on his day off. The pigeon came anyway.

epics.name: Lamplighter Leo
epics.concept: A copper lamplighter with a candle lit on his top hat.
epics.line: Lights the town's lamps at dusk, then the cup.

epics.name: Cinnamon
epics.concept: A knitted baker in the shape of a roll, in a knitted cap; a cinnamon roll on top.
epics.line: Knitted to look like a roll. Fooled a pigeon, briefly.

epics.name: Iron Ibex
epics.concept: A tin toy alpinist, his hat painted red, an ice axe on his back, sure-footed as an ibex.
epics.line: Climbs the hill to the green rather than take the path. Every time.

epics.name: Yodel
epics.concept: A walnut carving from the valley fair, his alphorn over his shoulder.
epics.line: Yodels at the tee. The echo usually says where the ball went.

epics.name: Cuckoo
epics.concept: A cuckoo clock's gnome, the clock's house on his hat, the bird out.
epics.line: Pops out every hour to check his score. Then pops back in.

epics.name: Apres
epics.concept: A knitted ski-lodge gnome with a mug of cocoa.
epics.line: Skis for the cocoa, putts for the marshmallows.

epics.name: Neon Slalom
epics.concept: Night skiing in neon: glacier light, lit skis crossed on his back.
epics.line: Took the black run in the dark. Lit the way himself.

epics.name: Edelweiss
epics.concept: A porcelain alpine girl, painted green, an edelweiss on her hat.
epics.line: One flower from the summit, painted on and picked fresh.

epics.name: Cairn
epics.concept: A gnome of piled stone, a cairn on his hat; every climber adds one.
epics.line: Every climber adds a stone. He is starting to feel it.

epics.name: Saint Barnabus
epics.concept: A glazed mountain rescuer with a keg of cocoa under his chin.
epics.line: Rescues stranded balls from the rough. Carries cocoa, just in case.

epics.name: Snowglobe
epics.concept: A glazed gnome holding a snowglobe with a pine inside.
epics.line: Shakes the globe before every putt. It snows, and he feels better.

epics.name: Copperbeard
epics.concept: A copper miner in a copper helmet, beard and all.
epics.line: Swung a pick for forty years. A putter feels like cheating.

epics.name: Geode
epics.concept: A stone prospector with a split geode on his hat, purple inside.
epics.line: Cracked himself open once. Purple inside, all the way down.

epics.name: Canary Kit
epics.concept: A glazed miner carrying the canary's cage; the canary sings.
epics.line: The canary sings on every hole. So far, so good.

epics.name: Panhandle
epics.concept: A carved prospector with his gold pan, nuggets in it.
epics.line: Panned every water hazard on the course. Found two balls and a ring.

epics.name: Neon Ore
epics.concept: Struck a glowing seam: amethyst light, crystals lit on his helmet.
epics.line: Struck a seam of something bright. Has glowed ever since.

epics.name: Dynamo
epics.concept: A brass automaton of a miner, gears turning on his helmet.
epics.line: Runs on gears and stubbornness. Mostly the second.

epics.name: Dusty Dee
epics.concept: Carved from the mine wall, a lantern lit for the others.
epics.line: Carved from the mine wall. Carries a lantern for the others.

epics.name: Moleskin
epics.concept: A knitted miner, a mole poking out of his helmet; the mole digs the holes.
epics.line: Knitted with a mole in the hat. The mole digs the holes.

epics.name: Nugget
epics.concept: A porcelain prospector, gilt at the edges, a big nugget on his hat.
epics.line: Gilded at the edges, cracked in the middle. Priceless, says his mum.

epics.name: Anvil Ada
epics.concept: A steel smith in goggles, her hammer on her back.
epics.line: Forges her own putters. They are heavy, and they go straight.

epics.name: Bellows
epics.concept: A carved smith working the bellows, soot on his cheeks.
epics.line: Blows on the ball when nobody is looking. Nobody is ever looking.

epics.name: Pumice
epics.concept: Pumice stone: light as a feather, hard as a rock, a map tucked under his arm.
epics.line: Light as a feather, hard as a rock. Floats in the water hazard.

epics.name: Heat-Suit Hal
epics.concept: A volcanologist in a silver heat suit, thermometer at his side.
epics.line: Measures the lava every morning. Then putts around it.

epics.name: Pineapple Pete
epics.concept: A glazed island souvenir from the volcano's warm side, a pineapple on his bandana.
epics.line: Grew up on the volcano's warm side. Sweet, spiky, slightly singed.

epics.name: Neon Magma
epics.concept: A hothead in lava-orange neon, a flame sign on his cap.
epics.line: Hot-headed by design. The sign says so.

epics.name: Kiln
epics.concept: A glazed potter fired at the volcano, a pot on his cap.
epics.line: Fired twice, glazed once. Cracks under pressure, but only on the green.

epics.name: Torchbearer
epics.concept: A carved cave explorer with a torch alight.
epics.line: Lights the way into every cave. Leaves the bats to the others.

epics.name: Kettle Tess
epics.concept: A knitted explorer who makes tea on the volcano's vents.
epics.line: Makes tea on the vents. Takes it black, like the rocks.

epics.name: Lightning Rod
epics.concept: A copper storm-watcher with a lightning rod on his hat.
epics.line: Stands tall in every storm. Has been struck four times and counting.

epics.name: Weathervane
epics.concept: A weathervane of a gnome, brass on top, his copper gone to verdigris, its rooster on his hat.
epics.line: Always faces the wind. Putts with it, mostly.

epics.name: Barometer Bea
epics.concept: A carved barometer-maker, the dial on her chest.
epics.line: Reads the weather off her dial. Pressure falling, putts dropping.

epics.name: Neon Nimbus
epics.concept: An apprentice who learned one spell: it makes things glow.
epics.line: Learned one spell. It makes things glow. That is the spell.

epics.name: Rainy Ray
epics.concept: A glazed gnome in a yellow sou'wester, umbrella up.
epics.line: Brought an umbrella to a sunny day. Was right by hole 3.

epics.name: Kite
epics.concept: A knitted gnome flying a kite on the windy holes.
epics.line: Flies a kite on windy holes. The ball flies with it.

epics.name: Cass
epics.concept: A porcelain fortune-teller's apprentice, crystal ball in hand.
epics.line: Saw the hole-in-one coming. Still missed it.

epics.name: Gargoyle
epics.concept: The clubhouse roof's stone guardian, small wings and all.
epics.line: Guards the clubhouse roof in storms. Plays on calm days.

epics.name: Hoot
epics.concept: A carved apprentice and the owl that knows the course by night.
epics.line: The owl knows the course by night. He just carries the clubs.
